[[Tennis]] returned to the [[Summer Olympic Games]] at the [[1988 Summer Olympics]] in [[Seoul]], having been left out since the [[1924 Summer Olympics]] in [[Paris]].  Tennis had been a [[demonstration sport]] at the  [[1968 Summer Olympics|1968]] and [[1984 Summer Olympics]].

The tournament took place from September 20 – October 1 on outdoor [[hardcourt]]s at the [[Seoul Olympic Park Tennis Center]].
